# quick match: PLAY WITH ANYONE joins the matchmaking queue (the ranked pool today; the separate unranked pool is on agent/anypool24), 60 s wait with nobody to play, cancel, back to the main menu
# Generated by tools/console-1.2/gen_online.py (edit the generator, not this file). One console, the real online service, no opponent: needs MSC_ONLINE_FRIENDS=1 (the tree does not offer FRIENDS / PLAY WITH ANYONE by itself yet); POST /v1/ranked/queue {}, polled until the cancel, DELETE on cancel
# Menus are driven by pad presses only; the public name comes from MSC_ONLINE_NAME in the run's np-player.txt (nothing is typed). Every screen logs a STATE line: a missing one is a TIMEOUT
# line of the script and the run is INVALID.
mash 100 20 scene == 0
log STATE title screen
mash 100 30 scene != 0
wait scene == 1 || scene == 10
wait scene == 10 || nbuttons >= 8
if scene == 10
log first run: no save file, accepting 'create save data'
wait nbuttons >= 2
idle 10
mash 100 30 scene == 1
wait nbuttons >= 8
endif
wait onctx == 0
log STATE main menu
idle 30
# The main menu is a ring picked by stick/D-pad angle; Multiplayer (ctx 1) is up-left.
hold 30 0 -80 80
wait onctx == 1 120
idle 10
log STATE pointer on multiplayer
idle 20
press 100
wait scene == 10 1200
log STATE multiplayer mode choice
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
idle 60
mash 8 15 onctx == 0 180
idle 10
press 100
log chose online
wait scene == 1 900
wait scene == 10 1200
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
log STATE online choice popup
idle 60
mash 4 15 onctx == 1 300
idle 10
press 100
log chose play with anyone
wait scene == 41 || scene == 10 3600
if scene == 10
log STATE first-time notice
idle 120
mash 100 40 scene != 10 1200
endif
wait scene == 41 3600
log STATE player count (quick)
idle 150
press 100
log chose one player
wait scene == 24 || scene == 49 2400
log STATE quick match searching
idle 1800
log STATE quick match searching waited
# a search that failed shows the game's own error popup over the search screen: it has one button and wants Cross (Circle does nothing there, and the route used
# to end stuck on it until its TIMEOUT). Cross closes it and the game leaves the online screens by itself; the route ends here with a clean exit and the run is
# INVALID by its missing STATE lines, with the reason in the log.
if scene == 10
log search FAILED: the game's error popup is up, closing it with Cross
press 100
idle 300
log STATE search failed (error popup closed)
exit
endif
press 200
idle 240
log STATE search cancelled
# back out to the main menu: Circle leaves a scene one step at a time (player count -> hub -> main menu); a Circle that is not needed is not pressed
idle 60
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
wait scene == 1 900
idle 60
log STATE back in the main menu
exit
